//: Appears at the ranch after you progress in the refugee center quests.  Faction critical.

no.yes: Morning sir, how can I help you?
no.no: Morning ma'am, how can I help you?

responses.text: [MISSION] The merchant at the Refugee Center sent me to get a prospectus from you.
I heard you were setting up an outpost out here.
Where can I find that many planks?
Hey, are you looking for workers here?  I know a couple people back at the refugee center that might be willing to come.

dynamic_line: I heard the crew at a lumbermill out in the woods kept their saw running.  They might have planks to spare.  I can mark the mill on your map if you want to check it out.  It doesn't matter to me where the planks come from.

responses.text: Mark it on my map.  I'll take a look.

name: Find the Occupied Lumbermill
description: Visit the Occupied Lumbermill.  The Tacoma foreman thinks its crew may have lumber for sale.

dynamic_line: I was starting to wonder if they were really interested in the project or were just trying to get rid of me.

Ya, that representative from the Old Guard asked the two of us to come out here and begin fortifying this place as a refugee camp.  I'm not sure how fast he expects the two of us to get setup but we were assured additional men were coming out here to assist us.

responses.text: How many refugees are you expecting?

dynamic_line: Could easily be hundreds as far as I know.  They chose this ranch because of its rather remote location, decent fence, and huge cleared field.  With as much land as we have fenced off we could build a village if we had the materials.  We would have tried to secure a small town or something but the lack of good farmland and number of undead makes it more practical for us to build from scratch.  The refugee center I came from is constantly facing starvation and undead assaults.

responses.text: Hopefully moving out here was worth it…

dynamic_line: I'm the engineer in charge of turning this place into a working camp.  This is going to be an uphill battle, we used most of our initial supplies getting here and boarding up the windows.  I've got a huge list of tasks that need to get done so if you could help us keep supplied I'd appreciate it.  If you have material to drop off you can just back your vehicle into here and dump it on the ground, we'll sort it.
we're still in early stages of getting set up, but we're not overly flush for hands, that's for sure.  If they're willing to put in a hard day's work, we can get them busy.

responses.text: I'll tell them that, but they seemed good for a bit of hard labor.

description: Bring 200 planks to Tacoma's foreman to enclose the barn.

dialogue.offer: We need to enclose the barn before the new arrivals move in.  Bring us 200 planks and we'll supply the rest and do the work.  I can pay you 40 Merch.
dialogue.accepted: The more men we can bring to the camp the quicker improvements can be made.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance.  We need skilled survivors.
dialogue.advice: Avoid destroying the furniture, we'll be needing it.
dialogue.success: That closes off the barn entrances.  Now we can make room for people to sleep inside.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

description: Obtain 25 blankets, fur blankets, electric blankets etc for the Tacoma Commune.

dialogue.offer: The barn is enclosed, but it's still cold inside.  We'll build bed frames in the stalls.  Bring us 25 blankets or equivalent bedding and I'll pay you 25 Merch.
dialogue.accepted: I'd start with looting hotels or you could sew them together… but that would be a last resort.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance.  We need skilled survivors.
dialogue.advice: Avoid destroying the furniture here, we'll be needing it.
dialogue.success: The beds are ready.  The new arrivals have a safer, warmer place to sleep now.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

description: Bring Tacoma's foreman 40 seeds of one crop: wheat, corn, barley, beans, potatoes, or carrots.

dialogue.offer: We have beds for the workers and land to grow on, but not enough seed to plant a field.  Bring 40 seeds of one crop: wheat, corn, barley, beans, potatoes, or carrots.  I'll pay you 10 Merch.
dialogue.accepted: One crop will give us enough for a proper planting.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance.  We need skilled survivors.
dialogue.advice: Try farm sheds and gardening stores, or prepare seed from produce.  Raw potatoes can be cut into seed pieces.
dialogue.success: The fields are ready for planting.  Look for the Crop Overseer if you want to trade for seed or tools.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

name: Secure Clean Water
description: Bring 50 steel pipes to Tacoma's foreman for <reward_count:FMCNote> Merch so the workers can finish the well and install a hand pump.

dialogue.offer: People are getting sick from the water we've been using.  We can dig and line a well ourselves, but we need 50 steel pipes for the hand pump and its fittings.  I'll pay you 24 Merch.
dialogue.accepted: We'll handle the digging and stonework while you're out.
dialogue.rejected: Let me know if you change your mind.
dialogue.advice: Look for steel pipes in workshops or salvage them from plumbing.
dialogue.success: The pump is ready.  We've finally got dependable drinking water, and you're welcome to draw from it.
dialogue.failure: We'll have to keep making do until we can finish the well.

name: Complete the Sawmill
description: Bring two electric motors to Tacoma's foreman for <reward_count:FMCNote> Merch to finish the local sawmill.

dialogue.describe: We need to start cutting our own lumber.
dialogue.offer: We've got clean water and the crew can put up a sawmill, but the machinery needs two electric motors.  Bring them here and I'll pay you 18 Merch.
dialogue.accepted: We'll use the mill for our own building and repairs.
dialogue.rejected: Let me know if you change your mind.
dialogue.advice: Check workshops and salvage yards for ordinary electric motors.
dialogue.success: The sawmill is ready.  We've also started the tool shed and outhouse.  Now we can turn our attention to the clinic.
dialogue.failure: The machinery will have to wait.

name: Open the Clinic
description: Bring Tacoma's foreman six matching first-aid kits so the clinic can open. Payment: <reward_count:FMCNote> Merch.

dialogue.describe: We need to open a clinic.
dialogue.offer: The crew can build a clinic, but the nurse needs supplies to open it. Bring me six first-aid kits of the same kind: compact kits, individual kits, or full kits. I'll pay you 72 Merch.
dialogue.accepted: We'll have a place ready for the nurse to work.
dialogue.rejected: Let me know if you change your mind.
dialogue.advice: Check pharmacies, clinics, and emergency supply cabinets. Bring the kits unopened.
dialogue.inquire: Have you found all six kits?
dialogue.success: The clinic is open. The nurse can treat injuries and sells basic medical supplies. We're not set up for surgery yet.
dialogue.success_lie: I still need six matching kits.
dialogue.failure: We'll have to wait to open the clinic.

dialogue.offer: We have the basic equipment that we need but without a functioning power grid we are forced to rely on the readily available vehicle batteries.  This is going to be a chore but I'll need twelve car batteries to swap between charging and powering our equipment.  The good news is that they don't need to be charged, we can take care of that.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance.  We need skilled survivors.
dialogue.advice: Cars can be found in traffic jams along roads or in parking lots…  I'm sure you can find a few.
dialogue.inquire: Do you have the car batteries?
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.offer: Check with the nurse when you get a chance, I know she will need help setting up our clinic.  On the construction front, we are going to need to get dedicated scavenger teams setup to bring in the miscellaneous supplies that we use in small quantities.  We are going to start setting up a junk shop for them in the North end of the outpost so we could use your help with that.  Communication is the biggest obstacle for the teams… could you bring in a pair of two-way radios?
dialogue.accepted: Organizing the scavenging missions is difficult enough without communication.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance.  We need skilled survivors.
dialogue.advice: You should be able to find them in electronics stores or at a police station.
dialogue.inquire: Do you have the two-way radios?
dialogue.success: I'm sure the scavengers will find these useful.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.offer: The volunteers for the scavenging teams will need to be issued some basic equipment.  When the boss sets up shop in the junk shed you should ask him what else he needs for his teams.  In the meantime we can provide a few backpacks to get them started.  Could you find five backpacks to give to the initial team?
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance.  We need skilled survivors.
dialogue.advice: It may be easier to make them if you can't find a school or something.
dialogue.success: Having at least basic equipment greatly increases survivability.  Thanks.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.offer: Growth has lately begun to stall, we have individuals passing through the outpost but the prospect of hard labor just to eke out an existence is driving them away.  We've asked around and decided that, despite our pressing needs, building a bar ought to draw some of the less committed individuals to the outpost.  Unlike other settlements, the more hands we have to more food we can produce… at least in the long term.  Unfortunately, no one here has brewed alcoholic drinks before so we are going to need you to find a book called the 'Homebrewer's Bible' or something along those lines.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance.  We need skilled survivors.
dialogue.advice: I guess you should search homes or libraries?
dialogue.success: I guarantee we will toast to your name when the bar is finished.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.offer: Just flipping through the book I can tell that one ingredient in most of the alcoholic drinks that we don't have a large supply of is sugar.  What alcohol we have been able to loot isn't going to last us long so starting our first large batch is a priority.  Could you bring in 80 units of sugar?  That should last us until we can start producing our own supply.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance.  We need skilled survivors.
dialogue.advice: You might get lucky finding it but you could always boil it out of fruit if you are familiar with the process.
dialogue.success: There is a large group of thirsty individuals in our outpost that are truly thankful for your work.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.offer: Although we are an agricultural outpost, we are restricted to growing plants that are compatible with the New England climate during the warmer months.  The easiest way to work around that is to build green houses to supplement our external fields.  There isn't going to be an easy way to build these, we are going to need a massive number of glass sheets to enclose the frames.  The first house will need 30 sheets of glass if you are still interested.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance.  We need skilled survivors.
dialogue.advice: Deconstructing existing windows is the only way I know of to keep the sheets intact.
dialogue.inquire: Do you have the glass sheets?
dialogue.success: We'll begin planting our first seeds as soon as we can get these installed.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…
